messages.subject: Rook through RApache slow
parts:
I was wondering if other people have the same experience, or if I am doing something odd.

So I deployed the rook test app literally like in the rapache manual:

<Location /test/RookApp>
        SetHandler r-handler
        RFileEval /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rook/exampleApps/RookTestApp.R:Rook::Server$call(app)
</Location>

Then when I open this file in my browser it works, but the transfer speed is terribly slow. Uploading a file of say 10MB, it takes 20 seconds to upload. To my localhost this is. Uploading the same file to any other RApache application on my localhost takes less then half a second.

Any ideas?
